title: Drag a shapes corner to round it
goal: Rounding one corner of a shape means typing a number into the panel. Photoshop and every drawing tool let you grab a small handle just inside a corner and pull it, watching the curve follow your hand. Give a picked shape that handle, one per corner, so rounding is something you do on the canvas rather than something you type.
notes: Follow-up from the audit for each-corner-of-a-shape-can-be-rounded-on-its-own (queue/audits/2026-09-08-each-corner-rounded.json, rough item 2). The model is already there: PhotonzCore/CornerRadii.swift with per corner numbers, and PhotonzDocument.setCornerRadius(layerIDs:corner:to:) writes one corner. What is missing is the canvas handle. Handles live in Sources/Photonz/CanvasDisplay.swift beside the eight resize handles; the outline itself already curves per corner via SelectionOutlineShape.path(box:cornerRadii:). Flag: next-shape-parts.
acceptance: A picked shape with corners shows a small handle just inside each of its four corners
Dragging one handle rounds that corner alone and the shape follows the hand live
Holding a modifier while dragging one handle rounds all four together
Letting go records one undo step, and the panel Corner Radius rows show what was dragged
